instrument: Current State Check (Vikriti), 6 items, Govardhan School of Yoga workbook
note: Ticks per dosha column, 0-6 each, for the last 4-6 weeks. Scored and stored separately from Prakriti; compared against the latest Prakriti result for interpretation. Thresholds follow prakriti.json vikriti_check.interpretation.

patterns.label: No marked imbalance
patterns.description: No column reaches three ticks, so nothing stands out as disturbed for you right now.

patterns.label: {doshas} elevated
patterns.description: Three or more ticks in a column is worth your attention. If it matches your Prakriti, your leading dosha has increased (the most common pattern). If it differs, season, travel, stress or lifestyle is pulling you away from your nature; address the current imbalance first.

patterns.label: Several doshas strongly elevated
patterns.description: Four or more ticks in several columns, or anything persistent, means you should see a qualified Ayurvedic physician rather than treat yourself.
